lede: Everything below happened on 2026-09-04 (EDT) through the orchestrator queue: the feature-by-feature review, the fix wave, the design wave, and the readiness pass. Automated evidence is in the last two sections; the middle sections are the checks only you can run on a phone, in a console, or as a decision.
callout: Tick as you go. With the shared record on, I can read your ticks and notes back and pick up the fixes without you writing a message.
changes_intro: Thirty-seven pull requests merged since Sep 3, grouped by the wave they belonged to. Every one went through an advocate + critic review pair before merge.

waves.name: Design wave (critique packages P0–P7)
waves.blurb: Every screen re-read against the design brief: minimal interactions, no keyboard where a control will do, no duplicated headers. The foundation package gates the rest.

waves.name: Fix wave (feature reviews)
waves.blurb: Each feature area got an advocate and a critic; their findings became these fix packages.

waves.name: Regressions and reliability
waves.blurb: Found by the acceptance runs and the simulator passes.

waves.name: Docs truth, audits and records
waves.blurb: The specs, the runbook and the changelog brought back to what shipped.

waves.name: Tooling, CI and dependencies
waves.blurb: Dependabot groups, the secret scan in CI, and the workflow fixes.

actions_intro: In order. The database applies come first because the Profile tab already depends on 0054 and two merged-ready PRs wait on 0047 and 0053. Every apply was rehearsed tonight on a fresh copy of production.

actions.title: Apply 0054 to production
actions.detail: Rehearsed 8/8 on the reset acceptance branch. Users see "Couldn't load your profile" until this is applied.
actions.command:
cd ~/code/pantry && git pull
psql "$NEON_DIRECT_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -1 -f supabase/migrations/0054_creator_profiles.sql
psql "$NEON_DIRECT_URL" -f db/asserts/0054_creator_profiles.sql   # expect: ALL 8 ASSERTIONS PASSED

actions.title: Apply 0053 to production, then replay the grants
actions.detail: From PR #161's branch. Rehearsed 16/16, grants replay clean, 0054 still 8/8 afterwards. Tell me when it is in and I merge #161.
actions.command:
git fetch origin && git checkout fix/db-integrity-2026-09-04
psql "$NEON_DIRECT_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -1 -f supabase/migrations/0053_merge_integrity.sql
psql "$NEON_DIRECT_URL" -f db/asserts/0053_merge_integrity.sql   # expect: ALL 16 ASSERTIONS PASSED
psql "$NEON_DIRECT_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/neon-grants.sql
psql "$NEON_DIRECT_URL" -f db/asserts/0054_creator_profiles.sql   # still ALL 8

actions.title: Apply 0047 to production
actions.detail: From PR #156's branch. Creates the empty USDA mirror; inert until the seed. Rehearsed 7/7. Then I merge #156.
actions.command:
git checkout feat/catalog-nutrition-matching
psql "$NEON_DIRECT_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -1 -f supabase/migrations/0047_usda_foods.sql
psql "$NEON_DIRECT_URL" -f db/asserts/0047_usda_foods.sql   # expect: ALL 7 ASSERTIONS PASSED

actions.title: Say yes or no to the USDA downloads
actions.detail: The 0047 seed needs three FDC datasets (~200 MB) from fdc.nal.usda.gov. With a yes I download, generate db/apply/usda-foods-seed.sql, rehearse it on the branch and hand you the apply line.

actions.title: Deploy the Worker
actions.detail: `wrangler deploy` from workers/ with your token; confirm BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, AUTH_BASE_URL, RESEND_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are set (`wrangler secret list`). The mini's wrangler is not logged in.
actions.command: cd ~/code/pantry/workers && npx wrangler secret list && npx wrangler deploy

actions.title: Cut a new EAS development build
actions.detail: app.json gained the webcredentials association (#174); the installed dev client runs the old native runtime until this is done.

actions.title: Rotate the seeded dev account
actions.detail: test@pantry.dev's password is documented in the repo; rotate before beta and put the new value in ~/agents/.env.acceptance on the mini (chmod 600).

actions.title: Anthropic console budget alert
actions.detail: The per-user cap and a provider-side alert fail differently; set the alert before any external tester.

actions.title: Sentry (ADR D13)
actions.detail: Create the project, set EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN in eas.json profiles, then enable source-map upload for production with SENTRY_ORG/PROJECT/AUTH_TOKEN as EAS secrets; verify one real crash arrives.

actions.title: RevenueCat go-live gate
actions.detail: Do not set REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET / REVENUECAT_SECRET_KEY yet. Condition (1), the webhook assert suite, is now green 12/12 on a production copy; (2) the last_event_at ordering migration and (3) the stale-event assert case are still open.

decisions.default: $2.99/mo · $24.99/yr · 7-day trial stays locked until you decide; recommended $4.99 · $29.99 · 14-day with an in-trial cap of 60 scans / 20 ideas. Decide before any product is created in App Store Connect (PR #182).
decisions.resolution: Locked: $4.99/mo · $29.99/yr · 14-day trial with an in-trial cap of 60 scans / 20 ideas. Being written into spec 23 and ADR D2 (PR #182); App Store Connect products and STATIC_PACKAGES must match when you create them.

decisions.q: Plus perks that have no spec yet
decisions.default: Themes and rich export deferred to their own specs; "priority shelf-life learning" dropped (spec 40 already applies corrections at once). Launch-day Plus = 300 scans / 100 ideas, unlimited members in owned households, 2000 photos (PR #182).
decisions.resolution: Default stands: priority learning dropped; themes and rich export deferred to their own specs; launch-day Plus = 300 scans / 100 ideas, unlimited members in owned households, 2000 photos.

decisions.default: A hashed-email grant ledger kept 13 months and disclosed in the policy; the alternative is granting only after email verification (PR #182).
decisions.resolution: Hashed-email grant ledger, kept 13 months, disclosed in the policy.

decisions.default: Approve with the amendments in my consolidated comment on PR #176; the merge is yours.
decisions.answer: no, not right now, after we finish this project
decisions.resolution: PR #176 parked until this project is finished.
